description: Manages associations or references between different entities or external resources within the system. This entity allows for linking various data points or external URLs to specific records.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of links associated with a specific entity and entity ID, with optional pagination.
example_uses: Get all links for a project with ID 123.
List links related to a user with ID 456, paginated.
Find all associated links for a specific document.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a collection of links filtered by a parent entity and its ID, with support for pagination.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link entry in the system.
example_uses: Create a new link for a project.
Add a new external resource link to a task.
Register a new internal document link.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to add a brand new link record to the system.

endpoints.name: Update
example_uses: Modify the URL of an existing link.
Change the description of a previously created link.
Update the associated entity for a link.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the properties of an already existing link.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link by its unique identifier.
example_uses: Remove a broken link from the system.
Delete a link that is no longer relevant.
Permanently remove a specific link record.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to permanently remove a link from the system using its ID.
